summary: Phase V — Adaptive Onboarding Engine. Backend POST /api/onboarding/briefing-summary verified (4/4 pytest tests pass: anonymous access, residential/commercial/hospitality category propagation, empty-payload fallback shape). Frontend /start-project wizard verified end-to-end (no auth needed): all 9 project_type cards render in step 1; Step 2 spaces are strictly category-scoped with ZERO crossover for all 3 categories (residential, hospitality, commercial); Step 2 headlines adapt correctly ('Which rooms would you like to transform?' / 'Which workspaces would you like to rethink?' / 'Which spaces will your guests experience?'); Step 6 lifestyle labels adapt correctly per category (feel/inspires/atmosphere rewritten); state RESET on project_type change verified (selecting 'meeting' in office flow, going back, switching to apartment → spaces array clean=[]); adaptive STEP X OF 7 counter present and accurate; wiz-saved-hint with bookmark icon + 'YOUR JOURNEY IS SAVED' visible on every step. Locale switcher on the wizard preserves answers (project_type/spaces/moods all survive) — confirmed via localStorage snapshot before/after.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the 'IT' chip in the wizard header preserves state (good) but the visible title/labels did NOT translate to Italian in the same Playwright run — wizard wording stayed English after toggle. May be a header-vs-wizard locale binding gap. Spec says 'Locale switching preserves answers' (confirmed) but the UX implication is that copy should also re-render in the new locale. Worth a manual main-agent verification.

Console floods with 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' — cosmetic; same issue observed in iteration_43. Some tags render with empty src instead of being conditionally rendered or set to null.

issues: Step 2 image shown for boutique_hotel flow is still the legacy bedroom photo (image is base.image, unchanged across categories). Functional copy adapts but the side imagery does not — consider category-aware imagery for full immersion.

action_items: [LOW] Verify wizard locale chip propagation: switching IT/EN/FR/DE/ES should retitle the wizard immediately. Answers already survive; copy did not visibly translate in test run.
[LOW] Clean up console warnings on the wizard (render null instead of empty string).
[OPTIONAL] Swap Step 2 image per category so hospitality/commercial flows don't show the residential bedroom photo.

[MAIN-AGENT SELF-TEST] End-to-end magic-moment (AccountCreationStep → /api/onboarding/private/submit → BlueprintGenesisOverlay → /workspace/projects/:id → FinalReady [data-testid=wiz-final-briefing]) not run by this agent to avoid creating throwaway supabase users. Recommend a single manual run with e2e-phase-v-<ts>@example.com / PhaseV2026! to confirm wiz-final-briefing renders and payload includes project_category + briefing_shape + ai_briefing.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/site/StartProjectWizard.jsx is ~760 lines and combines wiz chrome, all 7 step renderers, FinalReady and AccountCreationStep. Split per-step renderers into /pages/site/wizard/Step*.jsx for maintainability (soft cap is 700 lines).

onboardingGraph.js cleanly isolates the question-graph logic (categories, SPACES_BY_CATEGORY, STEP_COPY_BY_CATEGORY, STEP_GRAPH, visibleSteps, progressPercent, buildBriefingShape, resolveStep2/6Content) — excellent separation of concerns and zero hardcoded labels. No changes needed.

onboarding.py briefing-summary endpoint correctly: (a) is public/anonymous, (b) builds a deterministic fallback before any AI call, (c) wraps Claude call in try/except so AI errors degrade gracefully to fallback. emergentintegrations import is local (inside try) which is the right pattern.

BriefingSummaryBody is loose (Dict[str, Any]) — acceptable for this internal-shaped payload but consider tightening to a small Pydantic sub-model for briefing_shape so the response remains stable when frontend changes.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all adaptive graph behaviours verified; minor locale UX gap and cosmetic console warnings)

test_credentials: Phase V flow is anonymous — no credentials required. For the optional magic-moment self-test: e2e-phase-v-<timestamp>@example.com / PhaseV2026! (per request).
seed_data_creation: None. No DB writes. Wizard tested via localStorage scratch state only; account-creation submit not exercised to avoid creating real Supabase users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase V adaptive engine is rock-solid. Office NEVER shows bedroom; apartment NEVER shows meeting; hospitality NEVER shows commercial. State-reset on project_type change works. wiz-saved-hint and adaptive counter present. Backend /api/onboarding/briefing-summary returns the contractual shape with source=ai or source=fallback. Outstanding: (1) confirm wizard locale chip retitles copy, (2) e2e magic-moment with real signup to verify wiz-final-briefing appears in DOM after FinalReady. Backend pytest suite for Phase V lives at /app/backend/tests/test_phase_v_briefing.py — re-run with `pytest backend/tests/test_phase_v_briefing.py -v`.
rca of the issue: No critical issues. The only observable mismatch is the wizard locale chip click preserving state but not visibly retranslating copy in the same render — likely the locale chip rebinds SiteProvider locale, and the wizard's resolveStep2Content/resolveStep6Content do receive a fresh locale on next render, but title text may have been cached or rendered before re-render flushed in the Playwright timing window. Worth a quick manual re-check by main agent (toggle EN→IT→EN and watch Step 6 title). Not flagged as a regression because the spec's explicit requirement ('Locale switching preserves answers') is met.
